The popup option was never reached by a real key press; only a passive DOM/AX snapshot shows role=option and aria-selected. A snapshot is support bound to a causing key press, never standalone proof of keyboard-reachable state.

Evidence was recorded against the nearest Tab-reachable ancestor as a stand-in for the unreachable descendant option, without a reviewed owner/descendant mapping. That silent substitution is not evidence about the target.

Both OP-EMPTY and OP-OPTION remain UNTESTED; neither coverage claim is admissible.
